## What We Do

Super Next Technologies provides four core enterprise technology service lines:

### 1. AI Agents & Automations
We build custom AI agents and automation workflows for businesses. Services include:
- Marketing AI agents (brand monitoring, newsletter writing, SEO blog writing, competitor tracking)
- Operations AI agents (invoice tracking, automated reports, email alerts, project updaters)
- Sales AI agents (lead generation, AI SDR, meeting recording, recruiting automation)
- Support AI agents (email support bots, WhatsApp bots, SMS support, voice AI phone agents)
- Custom n8n workflow automation
- Chatbot and voice assistant development
- Integration with CRMs, ERPs, and third-party platforms

### 2. Enterprise Wireless Hotspots
We design, install, and manage enterprise-grade Wi-Fi and hotspot solutions for:
- Hotels and resorts
- Shopping malls and retail
- Offices and co-working spaces
- Airports and transportation hubs
- Universities and campuses
- Public venues and events

### 3. Cloud Infrastructure
We provide managed cloud and IT infrastructure services including:
- Cloud server setup and management (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, VPS)
- Cloud migration and modernization
- Enterprise networking and cybersecurity
- 24/7 monitoring and support
- Backup and disaster recovery

### 4. Website Development
We create professional websites and web applications for businesses:
- Custom website design and development
- E-commerce platforms
- Web application development
- SEO-optimized sites
- Mobile-responsive design
- Landing pages and templates
